script.text: Struggling to survive in the massive world of GTA 6?
These nine tips will help you master the game and keep your cash safe.
Always deposit your cash at a bank or an ATM, so you don't lose it if you get busted.
Pick deposit, choose the amount, and your money stays safe in your account.
Hit a clothing store and change your look to lose the police much faster.
Swap your hat and glasses to lower your recognition, and once it's cleared, cops can't ID you.
Search houses carefully, because cash is often hidden where you least expect it.
Look for loose floorboards and hidden spots like this one to grab extra money.
Gun stores sell everything from pistols to tactical rifles, so pick weapons that fit your style.
Then hold the loadout button to open your wheel and swap gear in seconds.
Use the gym equipment at home to train strength and improve your character's stats.
Exercises like deadlifts build muscle and boost your overall health over time.
Grab food and drinks from your fridge to restore health or get a quick stamina boost.
It's the easiest way to recover after a hard workout or a rough mission.
Always loot defeated enemies to collect extra cash, ammo, and weapons.
Clear the area of threats first, then take your time grabbing every pickup.
Scan cars with your phone to see which ones a buyer wants and what they're worth.
Locked cars need to be hotwired, and any car with an alarm will draw attention.
Pull up to a gas pump to refuel or repair your car on the spot.
It costs way less than replacing a wrecked car.
Thanks for watching! Subscribe for more GTA 6 tips and guides.
